note: The experience curve and the skill points a level grants (docs/54-experience.md). Read once when the world starts: restart the world after changing it.

first_level_xp.doc: Total experience level 1 to 2 costs (preforged gw_experience_level.h).

xp_per_level_step.doc: How much more each later level costs than the one before it; the same file gives level 20 at 140600 total.

max_level.doc: The highest level this curve reaches. The client's character sheet stops at 20.

skill_points_per_level.doc: Skill points each level grants on top of the previous level's total; level 1 has none.
